name: Mathenge Waweru
summary: I’m a Kenyan innovator building meaningful products at the intersection of fintech, hospitality, and technology.
currentFocus: I’m building Thenks, a fintech platform for Africa’s tourism industry that enables international travellers to tip, pay, and donate seamlessly across the continent.
portraitAlt: Mathenge Waweru holding the Kenyan flag on stage
mantra:
Express yourself.
Contribute to humanity.
Tell the story.
biography: With over five years of experience building ventures at the intersection of fintech and hospitality, Mathenge brings expertise in software engineering, product development, and entrepreneurship. He holds a First Class Honours degree in Informatics and Computer Science from Strathmore University. Previously, he co-founded Shukran, a venture-backed hospitality fintech startup, and served as a Product Development Fellow at Impact Africa Network.

His entrepreneurial journey began at university, where he led Enactus Strathmore to victory at the 2020 Enactus Kenya National Exposition. In 2024, he gained international recognition when his startup was named among the top 100 globally at the Entrepreneurship World Cup.
Passionate about technology, innovation, and impact, Mathenge is driven by a vision to build meaningful products that solve real-world problems and improve the lives of millions of people.
outsideWork: Outside the workbench: a mountain trail, good company, and the freedom of a ride on my Zontes 250V. The Mathnuscripts are where many of those questions become writing.
